messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up: prospect Equinox is blocked on their Dedicated POC. Trying to provision GPU pool in eu-central1, failing with reservation conflict + intermittent 429s. Need a quick swarm.
Diego Ramos: paste the exact error and which project/namespace?
Maya Chen: UI error: `403 ReservationConflict: reservation exists project:equinox-ml region:eu-central1` They retried and hit `429 provisioning_rate_limit`.
Diego Ramos: 403 usually means an existing reservation object tied to the same tenant. 429 suggests rapid retries from the UI.
Maya Chen: They ran our CLI and found a reservation id `res-91b` owned by `equinox-legacy` team; they don't have rights to delete it.
Laura (eng-platform): tagging eng-bot for audit. @eng-bot run reservation-audit eu-central1 for equinox org.
eng-bot: audit started. Found orphaned reservation res-91b created 2025-08-11T07:44:02Z under equinox-legacy, blocking namespace equinox-ml.
Diego Ramos: options: 1) eng-team force-delete orphan, 2) create PO C pool in eu-central2 as temporary workaround, or 3) disable az_affinity in reservation request to avoid conflict (but that may affect compliance).
Maya Chen: customer prefers single-AZ for now and said compliance team will accept single-AZ for POC if documented. Also asked about billing if we create pool in eu-central2.
Evan (sales-ops): region change = new reservation & billing. We'll issue a provisional 3-month reserved quote for 2xA100 in chosen region; note that reservations do not transfer.
Laura (eng-platform): I'll request forced delete of res-91b now. If we can't complete within 2 hours, we'll spin up eu-central2 pool for POC. Also recommend client add exponential backoff to reduce 429s.
eng-bot: delete job j-992 submitted. ETA ~20m.
Maya Chen: told customer we'll try deletion, otherwise spin up eu-central2. They're fine with single-AZ for POC.
eng-bot: job j-992 completed, res-91b removed at 2025-08-11T08:03:19Z.
Diego Ramos: great. Customer retried and provisioning succeeded. I'll draft a short runbook: CLI cleanup steps, backoff snippet, and note on billing for region switch.
Evan (sales-ops): I'll prepare the 3-month reserved quote and include language about non-transferable reservations.
Maya Chen: thanks team 389 closing this thread after I share quote to customer.
